2026_04_TEN_BAL.headline: Tennessee meets a Baltimore defense demanding a response after two shaky finishes
2026_04_TEN_BAL.paragraph1: Tennessee travels to Baltimore at 0-3 with an offense that has produced only 37 points, but the Ravens are openly demanding better defensive consistency after allowing 415 yards to Dallas and surrendering another late lead. That gives the Titans a path if they can protect, stay balanced and avoid early deficits. Baltimore still has the larger stress advantage with Lamar Jackson’s ability to create outside structure. Tennessee’s defense must contain explosive plays while making the Ravens sustain long drives instead of winning with sudden strikes.
2026_04_TEN_BAL.model_rationale: Baltimore’s defensive inconsistency gives Tennessee an opening, but the Titans must protect well and limit explosive plays to keep Lamar Jackson from controlling the game.
